<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','S','Y') and n['pixels']>10:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols),n['pixels']))
    return {k:v for k,v in out.items() if k!='S' or v[0][1]<50}
print("before:", state(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
